conservation.condition_narrative:
- Cockling and wrinkling in the paper overall. 
- The more thickly applied areas of paint have some cracking and losses. 
- Both top corners are missing and there is a tiny tear in the top edge, 1" from the right edge. 
- Some light scratches in paint surface. 
- There are scattered slightly brown inclusions scattered throughout the paper.

remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. An after 1965 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, April 1958." Completed in Virginia before August move to Texas, on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. Anita Pollitzer sketched this and cat. no. 94 from this series in a letter to O'Keeffe, written after receiving a bundle of work O'Keeffe mailed before leaving Virginia for Texas in fall 1916 (Anita Pollitzer to O'Keeffe, September 1916, in *Lovingly Georgia* [1990], p. 195). Pictured in 1917 New York (291) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 4. See cat. nos. 92–94. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
